registered_at: 2026-11-04 (before any X3 pilot or confirmatory output exists)
follows: config/p0_20261102.json (ARDY P0 goal task, experiment 2.4/2.5) and config/e4 cross-method E pipeline (python/scripts/run_e4_cross_method.py)
question: Do the ARDY three-layer conclusions (training layer accurate and smooth when the goal is visible early; output-layer cost grows with the correction; write-back causes the boundary jump; crossfade moves the cost to foot sliding) hold for an autoregressive policy method (DART) and two whole-sequence diffusion methods (Kimodo, OmniControl) under equal information?
anchor: ARDY is not rerun; its P0/E1/E2 results are the anchor cell. ARDY uses 20 s clips with goals at 4/8/12/16 s; DART mirrors that layout, whole-sequence methods use one goal per 10 s clip

development_smoke.data: /tmp prototypes only (not analyzed): MotionCorrection SMPL-X-22 wrapper on one OmniControl output (realism 0 / spatial 0 and 1/1) and one DART output from earlier runs
observed: Wrapper FK reproduction RMS 0.05 cm (OmniControl realism 0 spatial 0), 0.65 cm (OmniControl 1/1, generator bone stretch up to 7% left elbow), 0.45 cm (DART)
Native post_process_motion with a Root2D constraint 1.0 m off the run moves the root to 0.040 m from the target (= native root_margin); the correction spreads over about +-3 s
E4 smoke (before registration): DART unconstrained residual 0.13-0.19 BW, so an absolute C0 residual gate of 0.03 BW is not usable as the negative control

seed_note: Fresh seeds; P0 used 26-28, E4 used its own; smokes used none of these
cluster_unit: task (G = 12 per method); seeds and offsets are paired repetitions within a task
pairing: Same task, seed and offset across every arm of a method. C0 does not depend on the offset and is generated once per task-seed
goal_definition: Goal k = root XY (Z-up world) of the same-seed C0 run at goal frame T_k plus sign_k * delta * lateral_k. lateral_k is the horizontal unit vector to the body right of the C0 root velocity over the 0.5 s before T_k; if that speed is below 0.2 m/s the pelvis-facing direction (left-hip to right-hip cross up) is used. Implemented once in utils/motiogen/x3_tasks.py and used by every method

dart.tasks: 12 = text {walk, run} x 6 noise streams s = 0..5; goal sign pattern (+,-,+,-) for even s, (-,+,-,+) for odd s. Text set restricted to the reach policy's own training texts with root progression (hop excluded: in-place)
dart.noise: Primitive k uses torch.manual_seed(100000*(1000*task+seed)+k) for both the C0 noise and the policy sampling, so arms are identical until their first divergence

C0.definition: Native text rollout: EnvReachLocationMLD.step with action ~ N(0, I) (DDIM noise of the fixed denoiser); goals never shown

G0.definition: Fixed ReachLocation policy action only in the primitive whose future frames contain T_k (observation goal = goal k); C0 noise elsewhere. DART analogue of ARDY G0 (goal visible only inside its own window)

G4.definition: Policy action in every primitive starting within [T_k - 4 s, T_k) with observation goal = goal k; with 4 s spacing the policy acts from frame 0 and always sees the next goal

S.definition: Official optim_mld test-time noise optimization: start from the C0 noise sequence, Adam lr 0.01, 300 steps, unit-norm gradient, annealed lr, Huber loss on pelvis XY at the four goal frames, jerk and floor weights 0 (official defaults). Rollout is a differentiable re-execution of env.get_new_state_human (no autocast); replaying the C0 noise must reproduce C0 root XY within 0.01 m

W0.definition: C0 plus MotionCorrection (SMPL-X-22 wrapper, native post_process_motion, Root2D at T_k) applied to the primitive window holding T_k only; no write-back, the next primitive continues from the uncorrected state

W0X.definition: W0 plus a crossfade of the window correction into the following frames with half-decay 0.168 s (the value used for ARDY X0)

W1.definition: Corrected window written back into the DART history state before the next primitive. Conditional: the write-back requires converting corrected rotations to DART features; if the replay check (uncorrected write-back reproduces C0 within 0.01 m) fails, W1 is dropped and H4a is not tested; the decision is logged before confirmatory data

O.definition: C0 plus one MotionCorrection pass over the whole 20 s clip with Root2D at all four goal frames (same operation as the whole-sequence methods' O)

dart.boundaries: primitive boundaries recorded by the runner (every 8 frames)

kimodo.tasks: 12 locomotion prompts shared with OmniControl (see prompts); sign + for even task, - for odd task

C0.definition: Text only, constraint_lst empty, post_processing False

T.definition: Native Root2DConstraintSet at frame 180 (goal XY), constraint CFG weight at the default 2.0, post_processing False

T+.definition: As T with constraint CFG weight 4.0 (x2; analogue of ARDY C3b)

O.definition: C0 raw output passed to the native post_process_motion with the goal as Root2D constraint

TO.definition: T raw output passed to the native post_process_motion with the same constraint

kimodo.sampling_layer: structural gap: Kimodo has no native gradient guidance; no S arm

omnicontrol.tasks: same 12 prompts and signs as Kimodo
omnicontrol.hint: pelvis at frame 120: goal XY and the C0 pelvis height at that frame

O.definition: C0 plus MotionCorrection through the SMPL-X-22 wrapper, Root2D goal

prompts: A person walks forward with long strides.
A person walks forward swinging their arms.
A person walks forward and looks around.

output_wrapper.rig: Kimodo SMPLXSkeleton22 topology; rest offsets: SMPL-X neutral bone directions scaled to the run's median bone lengths, children of multi-child joints (pelvis, spine3) re-estimated from the run's mean local geometry
output_wrapper.ik: per-frame bone-direction alignment (minimal rotation for single-child joints, Kabsch for multi-child joints, identity for leaves)
output_wrapper.contacts: foot joint height < run minimum + 0.05 m and horizontal speed < 0.3 m/s
output_wrapper.gate: FK reproduction RMS <= 0.01 m per run; the max is reported
output_wrapper.correction: kimodo.postprocess.post_process_motion (native MotionCorrection, root_margin 0.04 m) on CPU; identical call for Kimodo O/TO, so all three methods share one implementation

metrics.goal_error: root XY distance to the goal at T_k, mean over a run's goals
metrics.jerk: common_step_jerk at the 0.1 s step (primary smoothness), per-frame jerk reported
metrics.boundary_jerk: common_step_boundary_jerk at DART primitive boundaries (DART only)
metrics.foot_sliding: foot_sliding_5cm_10cms: native_analysis.foot_sensitivity row height 0.05 m, speed 0.1 m/s (P0 definition); Kimodo SOMA toe joints mapped to left_foot/right_foot through adapters.ALIASES
metrics.E: E4 pipeline (biomech_sources.load, free_yaw) on all runs of the E arms at delta 1.0 m: residual force (BW, primary) and unsupported-frame fraction; validity gates as E1 (IK RMS <= 0.03 m, IK max <= 0.10 m, vertical force within 2%)

primary.family: One family per method; Holm at 0.05 over exact sign-flip p values within the family; each test also requires its 95% interval on the stated side. Kinematic tests pool both offsets (task mean over seeds and offsets of paired differences); E tests use delta 1.0 m
primary.H1b: T_arm - C0 jerk (0.1 s) non-inferior: (difference - 0.2 * mean C0 jerk) < 0
primary.H2: O - T_arm residual force > 0 (output-layer cost at the E criterion); goal errors of both arms reported alongside
primary.H3: S - T_arm jerk (0.1 s) > 0 (DART, OmniControl; Kimodo has no S arm)
primary.H4a: DART only, conditional on W1: W1 - W0 boundary jerk > 0
primary.H4b: DART only: W0X - W0 boundary jerk < 0
primary.H4c: DART only: W0X - W0 foot sliding non-inferior with margin +0.05: (difference - 0.05) < 0; a failure replicates ARDY's 'cost moves to foot sliding'
primary.H5: Descriptive, no test: where each method's output-layer cost appears (boundary jerk for DART; foot sliding / residual force for whole-sequence methods)

secondary: Every arm pair on every metric, per offset
Kimodo T+ - T (guidance dose), TO - T (adding output to conditioning); OmniControl TS - T, TO - T; DART G0 - C0, O - W0
Wrapper FK reproduction error and the generator's bone-length variation per arm
E unsupported-frame fraction for every E arm

inference.estimate: equal-weight task means of paired (task, seed, offset) differences
inference.interval: 95% cluster bootstrap over tasks, 10000 resamples, seed 20261104
inference.test: exact sign-flip over the 12 task means (4096 sign patterns)
inference.E_exclusions: a pair enters an E test only if both runs pass the validity gates; the all-runs result is reported as sensitivity

pilot.jobs: tasks 0, 3, 6, 9 with seed 40, every arm and both offsets; E at delta 1.0 m on the E arms
pilot.reuse: pilot outputs are reused in the confirmatory set only if no generation code changes after the pilot; otherwise they are regenerated
admission: intervention receipts: DART policy calls only in the registered primitives, S 300 optimizer steps with lower final loss, C0 noise replay within 0.01 m; Kimodo constraint list and CFG weights as registered; OmniControl realism/spatial call counts zero exactly when the arm switches them off
arms identical before their first divergence (DART C0/G0 before the first goal primitive, root XY within 1e-6 m)
wrapper FK gate on every O/W run
E IK validity >= 80% of pilot E runs per method (Kimodo: see kimodo_gate)
pilot.precision_rule: From the pilot task-level paired differences, projected 95% half-width at 12 tasks = 1.96 * SD / sqrt(12) / sqrt(2) (two seeds averaged within task). If it exceeds half the margin for H1b or H4c in any method, seed 42 is added for that method before confirmatory data are analysed
pilot.kimodo_gate: If the full E4 Kimodo IK pass rate is below 80%, the SOMA77 pelvis/hip marker mapping is revised using the pilot only and recorded as a pipeline revision; Kimodo kinematic results do not depend on it

grid.dart_generations: 12 tasks x 2 seeds x (C0 + 2 offsets x {G0, G4, S, W1}) = 216; W0, W0X, O are CPU post-processing
grid.kimodo_generations: 12 x 2 x (C0 + 2 x {T, T+}) = 120; O, TO post-processing
grid.omnicontrol_generations: 12 x 2 x (C0 + 2 x {T, S, TS}) = 168; O, TO post-processing
grid.E_runs: 24 task-seeds x 14 E arms = 336 at delta 1.0 m

estimated_hours: generation about 6 on two GPUs; E about 7 with 4 workers next to E3/E4, about 3 with 12 workers after they finish
compute_policy: Never interrupt E3/E4; GPU generation runs alongside them; X3 E runs go through e1_guard.py --protocol x3 with 4 workers until E4 finishes
deviations_from_plan: DART G0 is defined as policy-only-in-the-goal-primitive; a goal revealed exactly at T would equal C0 at T by construction (shared seeded noise)
DART gains an O arm (whole-clip output correction) so H5 compares one identical output-layer arm across all methods; W0/W0X stay window-level as in ARDY
The plan's C0 residual <= 0.03 BW negative control is replaced by within-method paired contrasts; E4 smoke already showed DART C0 at 0.13-0.19 BW. The E4 CLoSD runs remain the physics reference
E runs on 14 of 19 arms (E_arms) to fit the compute budget; the rest are kinematic only
conventions_not_derived: 约定，未经推演: offsets 0.5/1.0 m, goal times (DART 4/8/12/16 s, whole-sequence 6 s), alternating signs
约定，未经推演: lateral direction rule (0.5 s velocity window, 0.2 m/s fallback threshold)
约定，未经推演: H1b margin 20% of C0 jerk; H4c margin +0.05 as M2/P0
约定，未经推演: Kimodo T+ constraint CFG weight 4.0 (x2 of default)
约定，未经推演: wrapper contact rule (0.05 m, 0.3 m/s) and FK gate 0.01 m
约定，未经推演: crossfade half-decay 0.168 s reused from ARDY X0
DART S optimizer settings are the official optim_mld defaults; MotionCorrection root_margin 0.04 m is the native default
